summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Tips Sharing: Clothing Details Edition ## Introduction In this video, we discuss common issues encountered when creating a uniform skirt, particularly focusing on uneven folding and irregularity. ## Identifying Common Problems When you make a uniform skirt, you may usually encounter problems such as uneven folding and irregularity. As shown in the video, there will be irregularities after the skirt is completed. ### Causes of Irregularities The primary reason for these problems is that the skirt is folded while imitating the sewing line. To illustrate this, let’s walk through an example. ## Pattern Arrangement You may arrange the skirt pattern at the point of arrangement around the skirt, and then sew up these patterns. However, after this operation, irregularities will appear once the skirt is opened. ### Understanding the Sewing Line When making a skirt, it’s important to note that the skirt itself has a sewing line, but it does not have the folding angle yet. This means that the skirt cannot be folded effectively under the influence of the sewing line. ## Solution to Skirt Folding Issues The solution to this problem is quite simple: you need to fold the skirt first. ### Temporarily Anti-Activating Sewing Lines Here, we have added the sewing line. To proceed, we need to temporarily anti-activate these sewing lines. Click and drag the mouse button in the 2D window to select all the sewing lines in the skirt and anti-activate them. ### Ensuring Stability in the 3D Window In the 3D window, it is crucial to avoid intersections between the panels, as this may lead to instability. ## Applying Hard Fabric The hard-painted panel can apply a very hard fabric to the panel, making it easier for the fold to appear. The sewing line between the panels also needs to be anti-activated before starting the simulation. ### Simulating the Fold At this point, the panel will begin to fold. To prevent the panel from falling to the ground, you can pull it higher and simulate it again. If the panel folds more accurately, activate the sewing line. ## Finalizing the Skirt After folding, ensure to activate the sewing line again. Pay attention to check if any part of the waist belt has not been anti-activated. Once everything is activated, you can start the simulation again, and the sewing line will function properly. ### Activating Side Sewing Lines Lastly, remember to activate the side sewing line at the end. Sometimes, if the panel is relatively large, it may overlap, leading to instability. In this case, deactivate the hardening, let the panel fall naturally, and then activate the side sewing line. ## Conclusion At this point, your skirt creation process should be nearly finished. Please look forward to the next video for more tips. Thank you for your attention! ## Call to Action Don’t forget to subscribe to this channel. When you see the next video, please press the like button, and activate the bell notification. See you next time! Bye-bye. ```
